steps.text: Go to the cyclops and minotaur camp in the Plains of Havoc and down the stairs in the north building.
steps.source: Go down the stairs in the north structure (Mapper Coords 128.11, 125.235, 7).

steps.text: Go to the room straight south (lots of cyclopes and minotaurs, guards and mages): the giant smithhammer is in the chest.
steps.source: Once you go down these stairs, you will be faced with numerous Cyclopes, Minotaurs, Minotaur Guards, Minotaur Mages. The quest box is located in the room directly to the south.

steps.text: And a talon in the chest next to it.
steps.source: The quest box is located in the room directly to the south.
